summary.overview: In the recent M&A catch-up meeting, participants shared their weekend experiences before transitioning into key business discussions. David Tsutsumi provided updates on the NDA status, noting delays with Neptune and Outbrain while highlighting the need to expedite negotiations as Andrew Day stressed the urgency of pushing for offers before Christmas to facilitate discussions in the new year. Ahmed Zia presented on a new sales campaign targeting different sectors, prompting requests for progress updates. Discussions also covered email deliverability issues, with Andrew suggesting alternatives to Mailgun. Negotiations with the Israeli company Guiz were explored, focusing on stock inclusion and fees, while follow-up actions were assigned to ensure timelines and pending tasks remained on track. Action items included reminders for CACI regarding data reviews, updates on the sales campaign, and email service evaluations.

Ahmed Zia presented a new sales campaign targeting different sectors, prompting requests for updates on its progress. Email deliverability issues were also addressed, with Andrew suggesting alternatives to Mailgun. Additionally, negotiations with the Israeli company Guiz were examined, focusing on stock inclusion and fees, while follow-up actions were assigned to ensure that timelines and pending tasks remained on track.
